title: 50 Most Asked API Interview Questions
summary: Fifty backend/SDE interview questions on APIs, in short answers with key points and a diagram, table or snippet for each. They run from REST, HTTP and status codes through auth, security, pagination, rate limiting, caching, gateways, webhooks, versioning, testing and scalability to design scenarios.

chapters.title: API Interview Questions: What's Inside
points: REST and HTTP fundamentals
Methods and status codes
Authentication, JWT and OAuth 2.0
CORS and API security
Pagination, filtering, rate limiting and caching
API gateway and resilience
Webhooks and idempotency
Versioning, file uploads and long-running operations
Testing, monitoring and scalability
Real-world API design scenarios
Closing cheatsheet

chapters.title: API Interview Cheatsheet
points: Method table: safe and idempotent flags for GET, HEAD, PUT, PATCH, POST, DELETE
Status code quick map: 2xx success, 3xx redirect, 4xx client error, 5xx server error
Auth picks: session, JWT, API key, OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, client credentials
Pagination picks: offset for small stable data, cursor/keyset for large or live data
Rate limit algorithms in one line each, plus the 429 and Retry-After headers
Caching headers: Cache-Control, ETag, If-None-Match, 304
Reliability checklist: timeouts, retries with backoff and jitter, circuit breaker, idempotency key
Security checklist: HTTPS, validate input, object-level authorization, least-privilege scopes, rate limits
